title: Anthocyanin-enriched polyphenols from Hibiscus syriacus L. (Malvaceae) exert anti-osteoporosis effects by inhibiting GSK-3beta and subsequently activating beta-catenin.
authors: Karunarathne, Wisurumuni Arachchilage Hasitha Maduranga; Molagoda, Ilandarage Menu Neelaka; Lee, Kyoung Tae; Choi, Yung Hyun; Jin, Cheng-Yun; Kim, Gi-Young
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究木槿花多酚通过抑制GSK-3beta激活beta-catenin通路发挥抗骨质疏松作用，仅含分子对接但对象为小分子-激酶，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The bark and petal of Hibiscus syriacus L. (Malvaceae) have been used to relieve pain in traditional Korean medicine. Recently, we identified anthocyanin-enriched polyphenols from the petal of H. syriacus L. (AHs) and determined its anti-melanogenic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-oxidative properties. Nevertheless, the osteogenic potential of AHs remains unknown. PURPOSE: This study was aimed to investigating the effect of AHs on osteoblast differentiation and osteogenesis in osteoblastic cell lines and zebrafish larvae. Furthermore, we investigated whether AHs ameliorates prednisolone (PDS)-induced osteoporosis. STUDY DESIGN AND METHODS: Cell viability was assessed by cellular morphology, MTT assay, and flow cytometry analysis, and osteoblast differentiation was measured alizarin red staining, alkaline phosphatase (ALP) activity, and osteoblast-specific marker expression. Osteogenic and anti-osteoporotic effects of AHs were determined in zebrafish larvae. RESULTS: AHs enhanced calcification and ALP activity concomitant with the increased expression of osterix (OSX), runt-related transcription factor 2 (RUNX2), and ALP in MC3T3-E1 preosteoblast and MG-63 osteosarcoma cells. Additionally, AHs accelerated vertebral formation and mineralization in zebrafish larvae, concurrent with the increased expression of OSX, RUNX2a, and ALP. Furthermore, PDS-induced loss of osteogenic activity and vertebral formation were restored by treatment with AHs, accompanied by a significant recovery of calcification, ALP activity, and osteogenic marker expression. Molecular docking studies showed that 16 components in AHs fit to glucagon synthase kinase-3beta (GSK-3beta); particularly, isovitexin-4'-O-glucoside most strongly binds to the peptide backbone of GSK-3beta at GLY47(O), GLY47(N), and ASN361(O), with a binding score of -7.3. Subsequently, AHs phosphorylated GSK-3beta at SER9 (an inactive form) and released beta-catenin into the nucleus. Pretreatment with FH535, a Wnt/beta-catenin inhibitor, significantly inhibited AH-induced vertebral formation in zebrafish larvae. CONCLUSION: AHs stimulate osteogenic activities through the inhibition of GSK-3beta and subsequent activation of beta-catenin, leading to anti-osteoporosis effects.
abstract_zh: 背景：木槿（Hibiscus syriacus L.，锦葵科）的树皮和花瓣在韩国传统医学中被用于缓解疼痛。近期，我们从木槿花瓣中鉴定出富含花青素的多酚类物质（AHs），并确定了其抗黑色素生成、抗炎和抗氧化特性。然而，AHs的成骨潜力仍未知。目的：本研究旨在探讨AHs对成骨细胞系和斑马鱼幼鱼中成骨细胞分化和骨生成的影响。此外，我们还研究了AHs是否能改善泼尼松龙（PDS）诱导的骨质疏松。研究设计与方法：通过细胞形态学、MTT实验和流式细胞术分析评估细胞活力，并通过茜素红染色、碱性磷酸酶（ALP）活性和成骨细胞特异性标志物表达来测量成骨细胞分化。在斑马鱼幼鱼中测定了AHs的成骨和抗骨质疏松效应。结果：AHs增强了钙化和ALP活性，同时伴随MC3T3-E1前成骨细胞和MG-63骨肉瘤细胞中osterix（OSX）、runt相关转录因子2（RUNX2）和ALP表达的增加。此外，AHs加速了斑马鱼幼鱼的椎骨形成和矿化，同时伴随OSX、RUNX2a和ALP表达的增加。进一步地，PDS诱导的成骨活性和椎骨形成损失通过AHs处理得到恢复，并伴随钙化、ALP活性和成骨标志物表达的显著恢复。分子对接研究表明，AHs中的16种成分与葡萄糖合成酶激酶-3β（GSK-3β）结合；特别是isovitexin-4'-O-glucoside以-7.3的结合分数最强地结合到GSK-3β的肽骨架上的GLY47(O)、GLY47(N)和ASN361(O)位点。随后，AHs使GSK-3β在SER9位点磷酸化（非活性形式），并将β-catenin释放到细胞核中。用Wnt/β-catenin抑制剂FH535预处理显著抑制了AH诱导的斑马鱼幼鱼椎骨形成。结论：AHs通过抑制GSK-3β并随后激活β-catenin来刺激成骨活性，从而产生抗骨质疏松效应。
